jobs.title: Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT DASH0

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in.



The Opportunity

This is not a relationship maintenance role — it's a strategy and building role. You'll own the two channels providing the most leverage for Dash0's next phase of growth: hyperscaler marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure) and the cloud-native consultancy ecosystem that influences every enterprise buying decision.

Your mission is to build the motion from near-scratch: partner program design, commercial frameworks, co-sell enablement, and field activation. You'll simultaneously work live deals through hyperscaler channels where the opportunity is immediate. Based in Amsterdam or London (remote).



What You'll Do

 - Own the relationships with AWS, GCP, and Azure — drive Dash0 onto marketplace listings, activate co-sell motions, and turn field relationships with Cloud Solution Architects into a repeatable source of qualified pipeline.

 - Design and execute a partner model for cloud-native SIs and consultancies — the firms that spec observability stacks for enterprise clients. Define the incentive structure and co-delivery model.

 - Drive revenue through partners — you'll be measured by ARR contribution: net-new logos sourced through partners and accelerated deals via SI influence.

 - Feed partner and SI intelligence back into product, pricing, and positioning. Proactively address competitive movements.

 - Build and document relationships with hyperscaler solution architects in target geographies (US East Coast, UK/Netherlands/DACH) to generate qualified introductions.



What You Bring

 - 5+ years in partnerships, alliances, or business development at a developer tools, observability, or cloud-native infrastructure company.

 - Established relationships with field teams at one or more of the major hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

 - Demonstrated experience building or scaling a hyperscaler co-sell motion — from listing to active deal flow.

 - Experience designing partner programs for SIs or consultancies (tiers, incentives, enablement) at a technical product company.

 - A track record of partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue.

 - A builder mentality — you're energized by the ambiguity of standing up something new and prefer creating the playbook to following one.



Nice to Have

 - Background in observability, APM, or DevSecOps.

 - Experience with the OpenTelemetry or Prometheus ecosystems.

 - Existing CNCF community relationships.

 - International experience spanning US and Europe.



Why Dash0

This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started.

If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.



What we offer:

 - Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation — you'll own part of what you're building

 - Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich

 - €60/month phone & internet allowance

 - Location-specific benefits

 - Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset

 - Clear path for career growth and development

 - Direct access to founders and leadership

jobs.title: Founder Associate / Growth Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT DASH0

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in.


THE OPPORTUNITY

Dash0's growth team is responsible for finding out where our next customers come from and building the systems that get them there. That means developing and testing growth strategies across marketing and sales, analyzing what moves sign-ups, pipeline, and revenue, and turning the answers into programs, plays, and automations that run at scale.

We are looking for an early-career to mid-level Founder's Associate/Growth Manager/Growth Associate with a strong bias for ownership and pace. If you are analytical, commercially minded, and love running structured experiments from acquisition to expansion, this is your opportunity to build a high-velocity growth engine from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

 - Funnel & Data Analysis: Analyze funnel, pipeline, and product-usage data to identify the biggest growth opportunities and turn findings into clear recommendations for growth, sales, and product teams.

 - Sales Automation & Growth Plays: Develop signal-based outreach, account prioritization models, and expansion triggers for sales, building the automations in HubSpot and n8n that make them run seamlessly.

 - Growth Marketing Initiatives: Design and execute growth campaigns across content, community, partnerships, and paid channels, measuring their direct impact on qualified sign-ups and pipeline.

 - Structured Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments across the entire funnel—from acquisition and activation to expansion—backed by clear hypotheses and success metrics.

 - Onboarding & Conversion Optimization: Audit the sign-up and onboarding journey, pinpoint drop-off points, and collaborate with product and engineering to ship conversion fixes.

 - Growth Reporting: Build clear dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide the entire company with a single, consistent view of growth metrics—from site traffic to ARR.
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - Analytical & Rigorous: You sanity-check numbers before sharing them, distinguish real trends from noise, and can explain complex findings to any audience in a few concise sentences.

 - Commercially Instinctive: You understand how developers evaluate and buy tools, and you can translate those insights into a campaign, an experiment, or a sales play.

 - Owner's Mindset: You move fast and prefer shipping a good version this week over waiting for a perfect one next quarter. You follow through on projects until results are measured.

 - Technical & System-Minded: Comfortable working with automation tools (n8n, HubSpot) and data structures to build repeatable growth loops.
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in growth, revenue operations, or technical roles at a tech or SaaS company (early-career to mid-level).

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with professional fluency in English.

 - Strong track record of owning cross-functional projects across marketing, sales, and product.
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience marketing or selling to developers, or familiarity with developer-tools go-to-market.

 - Experience running structured experimentation programs or product-led growth (PLG) loops.

 - Familiarity with the observability, DevOps, or developer infrastructure ecosystems.

 - Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth, venture-backed startup environment.

Why Dash0

This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started.

If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.



What we offer:

 - Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation — you'll own part of what you're building

 - Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich

 - €60/month phone & internet allowance

 - Location-specific benefits

 - Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset

 - Clear path for career growth and development

 - Direct access to founders and leadership
